__meta: REUSABLE. D365 routing-stage distribution. Azure Monitor Logs over conversation-diagnostics subscenario (reuses Dynamics/Queries/routing-queue.kql). Timeseries by subscenario — the routing/queue distribution panel from the E2E pane, promoted to a shared panel.
title: Routing / queue — D365 subscenario distribution
description: Dynamics 365 routing-stage distribution over time, from conversation-diagnostics telemetry.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated $__timeFilter()
| extend cd = parse_json(Properties)
| extend Subscenario = tostring(cd['powerplatform.analytics.subscenario'])
| where isnotempty(Subscenario)
| summarize Events = count() by Subscenario, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
